observations: For the 2026-09-22 US session, Reuters reported the Nasdaq reaching a fresh intraday record while the S&P 500 was slightly lower and the Dow fell more than 290 points, showing technology leadership but mixed broad-market breadth.
Barron's reported the PHLX Semiconductor Index up about 1.1% for a sixth consecutive gain, extending AI/semiconductor leadership.
A same-session official or independently verified closing VIX observation was not obtained in the free evidence set, so the volatility leg remains incomplete.
Barron's reported the US 2-year Treasury yield around 4.714% and the 10-year around 4.928% on 2026-09-22, with a flatter curve and continued inflation concern.

FRED reported a 2026-09-22 yield of 2.635% for the 10-year 0.5% Treasury Inflation-Indexed Note due 2028, providing a current real-rate observation for this review rather than leaving the real-rate leg empty.
Reuters reported Boston Fed President Susan Collins supported the September rate increase because of elevated inflation risk and noted the Fed had signalled a possible additional hike later in 2026.

C.engine: Japan/Korea indices and FX, Asian opening
observations: Reuters reported South Korean stocks up about 0.9% on 2026-09-23, with Samsung nearly 1% higher, while Taiwan gained about 0.8% as AI-related risk appetite remained constructive.

Japan's cash market was closed for a holiday, so there was no fresh Nikkei cash-session print to obtain; Nikkei futures were about 1,760 points above Friday's cash close. This is a calendar-driven absence rather than an unverified missing observation.
Reuters reported USD/JPY around 157.76, with the dollar firm and the yen weak.
Reuters reported the CSI300 down about 0.5% and the Hang Seng Index down about 0.8% by the 2026-09-23 lunch break as investors tempered expectations ahead of the US-China leaders' meeting.
HKAB published 2026-09-23 HIBOR fixings: overnight 2.34333%, 1-week 2.42030%, 1-month 2.88571%, 3-month 3.11566%, 6-month 3.47726% and 12-month 3.90833%.

Free current-session sources indicated a softer offshore yuan near 6.70 per US dollar and weaker Hong Kong technology shares, but a single independently verified post-close HSI/HSTECH/CSI300/CNH bundle was not obtained.
Southbound-flow evidence is handled separately in engine G and is not inferred from index price or turnover.
Reuters reported oil falling for a sixth consecutive session on 2026-09-23 as supply concerns eased and hopes for US-Iran diplomacy increased; Brent was below $100 and near two-week lows.

The same Reuters global-market report stressed that a durable restoration of Strait of Hormuz flows would matter for inflation and rates, while also warning that previous de-escalation hopes had reversed quickly.
Gold had softened as higher-for-longer rate expectations persisted, leaving the macro impulse mixed: easing oil pressure is supportive, but geopolitical and monetary-policy risk remain material.

F.engine: policy execution, first-party business information, industry opinion, personal/social sentiment
observations: The HKMA/TMA Treasury Markets Summit held in Hong Kong on 2026-09-23 provided same-session first-party policy evidence: HKMA Chief Executive Eddie Yue outlined initiatives to deepen offshore RMB liquidity, encourage bond issuance, modernise infrastructure and support digital and cross-border fixed-income activity.
The 2026 Hong Kong policy framework remains supportive of mutual market access, capital-market liquidity and innovation/technology development.

Reuters' current market reporting continued to show constructive AI-industry evidence, but a broad, verified same-session personal/social-sentiment sample was not available and was not inferred from market prices.

HKEX remains the preferred authority for daily Stock Connect statistics, but a directly verifiable official 2026-09-23 Southbound net-flow value was not exposed in the free evidence path used for this run.

Two same-day secondary reports conflict materially: one reports Southbound net selling of HKD 6.792 billion and another reports net selling of HKD 2.754 billion. The discrepancy is not reconciled by an official current-session source, so neither figure is promoted to Authority.

No current-session source was found that can reliably decompose foreign/local/passive/retail/arbitrage participation. Investor identity is therefore not inferred from turnover, price action, or Stock Connect net turnover.

qualitative_read.directional_summary: Cross-market evidence is mixed rather than cleanly risk-on or risk-off: US and Asian semiconductors/AI remain firm and oil has eased below $100, but US rates remain restrictive, Hong Kong/China equities weakened during the session, and current-session capital-flow attribution is not verified.
qualitative_read.reason_for_no_regime: The accepted contract explicitly states that its inherited exposure bands are not fitted/validated and must not be applied from incomplete engines. Engine G is materially incomplete and engines A, D and F retain same-session evidence gaps, so a bounded formal regime label and numeric position ceiling are not authorized.
